dct_creator_sm: Christensen, Brenda (Department of Animal Biosciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0005-3073-9521
dct_description_sm: This dataset is from a feeding trial of a hydrolyzed yeast product from AB Agri fed to late gestating and lactating primiparous sows in 2023 conducted at the Arkell Swine Research Station in Guelph, ON. Sows were fed either a control diet or one supplemented with 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 or 1.2% of the hydrolyzed yeast. Offspring were followed until weaning at 19 days of age.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Dose-response of inactivated yeast in diets of late gestating and lactating gilts on immunoglobulin transfer and offspring preweaning growth performance
